title: Voice profile management tools — list, create, rename, delete
source_plan: User request: full agent control over voice profiles with visible table overview and CRUD operations. Currently only re_enroll exists for updating owner profile. SpeakerGallery class already has methods (enroll_guest, rename_speaker, remove_speaker, list_speakers, audit) but they're not exposed as agent tools. Requirements: plain text table output for list_profiles, placeholder creation for guests (no voice recording), audio feedback (success beeps) for create/rename/delete operations.
notes: Design: add 4 new direct tools (list_profiles, create_profile, rename_profile, delete_profile) following existing patterns in tool_registry.py and direct_tools.py. Add new IndicationKind entries for audio feedback (PROFILE_CREATED, PROFILE_RENAMED, PROFILE_DELETED). Output format for list_profiles is plain text ASCII table (not Rich console) since agent responses are spoken/text. create_profile makes placeholder profiles (empty embeddings list) that auto-enroll can fill later. Owner profile cannot be deleted.
